# Food Operations Platform

> Enterprise event-driven microservices food operations platform built with Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud Gateway, Apache Kafka KRaft, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, React 18, Redux Toolkit, Node.js 22, and FastAPI.

## Core Documentation
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Universal guide for AI coding agents with commands, service matrix, and boundaries
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): Claude Code specific commands and rules
- [Architecture Overview](./docs/architecture/overview.md): C4 system context, container, and component models
- [Event Catalogue](./docs/architecture/event-catalogue.md): Kafka topics, schemas, and saga choreography flows
- [SQL Optimization](./docs/architecture/sql-optimization.md): PostgreSQL 16 trigram search benchmarks and query plans
- [Operations Runbook](./docs/runbook.md): Production operational playbooks, failure recovery, and alerts
- [Interview & Design Notes](./docs/interview-notes.md): Engineering tradeoffs and concurrency reasoning
